from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Party(BaseModel):
    """A named party involved in the case."""
    name: str = Field(description="Name of the party as written in the document")
    role: str = Field(description="Role of the party (e.g., Appellant, Appellee, Petitioner)")

class FeeInfo(BaseModel):
    """Information about a court fee mentioned in the document."""
    fee_type: str = Field(description="Type of fee (e.g., 二审案件受理费)")
    amount: str = Field(description="The fee amount as written")
    payer: str = Field(description="Who bears the fee, as written")

class Document(BaseModel):
    """A single judgment document parsed for relevant matching features."""
    doc_type: str = Field(description="Type of legal document (e.g., 二审民事判决书, 再审审查裁定书)")
    parties: list[Party] = Field(description="Parties involved in the case")
    fees: list[FeeInfo] = Field(description="Court fees and their allocation")
    conclusion: str = Field(description="The court's main ruling or conclusion")
    case_numbers: list[str] = Field(description="Case numbers or docket IDs mentioned")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Container for all parsed documents from the collection."""
    documents: list[Document]
